items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could be ready to play vs. Bills
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Jackson (ankle) is "in a decent spot" to play Sunday against the Bills, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Not ready for practice
items.text:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Remaining starting quarterback
items.text:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the team's starting quarterback in Sunday's game against the Jaguars, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jadarian Price: Return to practice on tap in Week 8
items.text:
Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price (chest) will be designated for return from injured reserve during Week 8, Gregg Bell of Sports Radio 93.3 KJR Seattle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Avoids significant knee injury
items.text:
The left knee injury that forced Jones out of Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts isn't considered significant, and the running back is viewed as day-to-day, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
